instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Open the provided init.ifc bungalow shell in Bonsai and rework it into a five-room plan using native IFC authoring tools. The init model is only the starting shell: it contains one project, one building storey, four exterior shell walls, and one slab, but it does not already contain the required spaces, interior partitions, doors, windows, or hosted openings. Save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc. The result should contain one project, one building storey, five spaces, seven walls, one slab, three doors, two windows, five opening elements, five void relationships, and five fill relationships. Name the spaces Living, Bed 1, Bed 2, Bath, and Kitchen. Name the walls Shell-S, Shell-N, Shell-W, Shell-E, Part-1, Part-2, and Part-3. Do not include building element proxies or furnishing elements. Every door and window should fill one opening, and every such opening should void an IfcWall. Other details may vary.
